label: Charges only with wiggling or one cable; wireless charging works
check_hint: Try two cables and a wall socket; does wireless or MagSafe charging work?

label: Does not charge with any cable or wirelessly
check_hint: 30 min on a wall socket with two cables, then force restart

label: Does not turn on
check_hint: Charge one hour, then volume up, volume down, hold side button

label: Stuck on Apple logo or restarts by itself
check_hint: Does it pass the Apple logo and reach the lock screen?

label: Screen black or not responding to touch
check_hint: Does it ring or vibrate while the screen stays black?

label: Lines green line flicker or tint on screen
check_hint: Open a plain white page; any line or tint?

label: Faint ghost image stays on screen
check_hint: Plain grey image at full brightness; any keyboard or bar outline?

label: Ghost touch or dead touch area
check_hint: Drag a jiggling app icon to every corner; does it drop?

label: Screen or back lifting from battery
check_hint: Does the screen lift at an edge or the phone rock on a table?

label: Battery health reading may be faked
check_hint: Read cycle count and date of first use in Battery Health (iPhone 15 and later)

label: Face ID not working or not available
check_hint: Settings > Face ID & Passcode > Set Up Face ID

label: Rear camera black blurry or shaking
check_hint: Open Camera; try every zoom; any black blur or buzzing?

label: Selfie camera black or blurry
check_hint: Switch to selfie camera and take a photo; then test Face ID

label: Glass over rear camera cracked
check_hint: Look at the glass rings over the rear lenses

label: Flashlight does not work
check_hint: Control Center > Flashlight

label: Phone is bent
check_hint: Lay it screen-down on a flat table; does it rock?

label: Power volume or Action/mute button fault
check_hint: Press each button; does the volume bar, lock or silent icon show?

label: Loudspeaker silent or crackling
check_hint: Settings > Sounds & Haptics; drag the ringtone slider

label: Cannot hear callers at the ear
check_hint: Make a call and hold it to the ear

label: Callers cannot hear you
check_hint: Voice Memos: record and play back

label: Phone does not vibrate
check_hint: Flip mute switch or press Action button; any buzz?

label: Wi-Fi or Bluetooth greyed out
check_hint: Settings > Wi-Fi: switch grey after a restart?

label: No Service or Searching with a working SIM
check_hint: Insert a working SIM; toggle Airplane Mode; is IMEI blank in About?

label: Locked to a foreign network
check_hint: Settings > General > About > Carrier Lock says No SIM restrictions?

label: eSIM only with no SIM tray
check_hint: Is there a SIM tray on the side?

label: Has entered water or liquid
check_hint: Any liquid-detected alert? Red indicator in SIM slot?

label: Locked to another Apple Account
check_hint: After erase, does setup ask for someone else's Apple Account?

label: Company or school managed phone
check_hint: Settings > General > VPN & Device Management shows an organisation?

label: Marked lost or IMEI blocked
check_hint: Does the lock screen show a lost message?

label: Seller cannot unlock or phone says Unavailable
check_hint: Can you unlock it and sign out of your Apple Account?

label: iCloud was bypassed
check_hint: Was it ever bypassed or unlocked by a shop?

label: Logic board shows Unverified
check_hint: Parts and Service History: Logic Board Unverified?

label: A part shows Finish Repair
check_hint: Parts and Service History: Finish Repair next to a part?

label: Model in Settings differs from the claim
check_hint: Settings > General > About: Model Name and Model Number
